core_minimum_level.note: Only the current TH18 L101-L110 base-attack contract is enabled. Earlier inherited hero rows lack verified direct-damage values.

support.note: Core exposes only deterministic base movement, no-preference ground targeting and attack cadence. Hero abilities, equipment, pets and defending-altar behavior are intentionally absent.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only hero L1-L105 with no Core identifier, damage values or TH18 L106-L110 records.
changed_values.replacement: The current TH18 base-attack slice L101-L110 becomes materializable through the shared Core path, with a hash-pinned L106-L110 observation and current DPS-derived impact values.
changed_values.justification: The cited current table and official TH18 level announcement are sufficient for a narrow direct-attack baseline. It is not presented as a complete Hero implementation.

known_uncertainties: The current numeric source is secondary and explicitly warns that its hero records could not be independently cross-checked. No primary source publishes base HP, damage or cadence values.

No consulted source gives a deterministic base contact timing, collision radius, target-loss order, wall interaction, projectile or visual contract. Core uses its existing deterministic direct-melee route and treats this as partial.

Hero abilities, equipment, pets, altar wake range, defending-hero state, regeneration, ability buttons, healing, rage, invulnerability, spawned units and spell interactions are outside this increment and remain disabled.
No source-verified public Barbarian King sprite tier, placement, scaling or animation was found. The Viewer must not claim visual conformity.
conclusion: Barbarian King L101-L110 base movement and ordinary ground attack are a source-traced partial adapter integration. It is deliberately not a full Hero, and no ability, equipment, pet, altar-defense or placeholder asset behavior is claimed.
